features.name: sealed puzzle chambers
features.notes: Fully enclosed rooms with visible walls and boundaries
features.quote: Sealed Chambers: Fully enclosed rooms that physically hold the player

features.name: oversized keyboard floor
features.notes: Floor made from large individual keys in a standard computer keyboard arrangement
features.quote: a floor made of large keys representing a standard computer keyboard

features.name: letter key tiles
features.notes: Letter tiles suitable for crossing a word sequence including ESCAPE
features.quote: correct sequence of letter tiles on the floor to spell a specific word (e.g., "ESCAPE")

features.name: dangerous function keys
features.notes: Include distinct Delete and F4 key tiles among trap-capable tiles
features.quote: specific keyboard tiles (like "Delete", "F4", or randomized letters)

features.name: green correct key highlights
features.notes: Correct sequence keys visibly colored green
features.quote: changes a key's color to green for 1 second if it is a correct step

features.name: red neon trap keys
features.notes: Trap tiles visibly colored red or neon
features.quote: or red/neon if it is a trap

features.name: locked word puzzle door
features.notes: Door positioned beyond the keyboard puzzle area
features.quote: a locked door that only opens when a player walks across the correct sequence of letter tiles

features.name: reachable puzzle inputs
features.notes: Levers, keypads, or pressure plates mounted within player reach
features.quote: Levers, keypads, and pressure plates mounted where players can reach them

features.name: clue facade wall
features.notes: Feature wall directly along the natural camera path with a visible riddle pattern or hint
features.quote: Clue Facade: A feature wall placed directly in the player's natural camera path, hosting a riddle, pattern, or hint

features.name: sequenced unlock barrier
features.notes: A distinct barrier beyond an earlier puzzle section
features.quote: Sequenced Unlock: A barrier that opens only once an earlier puzzle in the chain is complete

excluded.name: Luau scripts
excluded.why: code implementation not visible in scene render
